pages.title: Q4 Launch
html:
Goal: launch the Lumen city e-bike subscription before the holidays. #launch

Background: [[Pricing review 2026-10-20|October pricing review]] and [[Launch meeting 2026-11-03]].

Open questions live in [[Risks]].

pages.title: Risks
html:
Supplier lead times for frame batch 2 are not confirmed. #risk

Pilot cities may not have enough repair partners.

pages.title: Launch meeting 2026-11-03
html:
Attendees: Priya (product), Sam (ops), Lee (finance).

Decided: run a pilot in two cities before any national launch. Lee asked for four weeks of pilot data first.

Pricing: keep the $29 per month plan for the pilot. The $39 premium tier waits until we have churn data.

Actions: Priya drafts the pilot plan by Nov 12. Sam books the two pilot cities. Someone needs to check supplier lead times.

Links: [[Q4 Launch]] #launch #pricing

pages.title: Pricing review 2026-10-20
html:
Options: A) $29 per month, B) $39 per month with insurance, C) pay per ride.

Rejected option B for now: churn risk without pilot data. Rejected C: too hard to forecast.

See [[Q4 Launch]]. #pricing
